description: Make a to-do repeat, change how a repeating to-do repeats, or stop it. Copies already finished or overdue keep their dates.

repeat.description: The new repeat settings. A one-off becomes a series; a series gets the new settings from here on.

days_of_week.description: Custom weekly only: which weekdays, e.g. ["mon","thu"]. Default the start date's weekday.

end_count.description: With ends=after_count: how many copies in total.

end_date.description: With ends=on_date: last possible date, YYYY-MM-DD.

ends.description: When the series stops. Default never.

every.description: Custom only: repeat every N units. Default 1.

frequency.description: How often. daily/weekly/monthly/yearly repeat on the start date's weekday or day of month; custom uses every + unit and the options below.

monthly_on.description: Custom monthly only: the start date's day number (the 15th), its weekday position (the third Tuesday; the last one if it is the final such weekday), or the last day of the month.

next_copy.description: when_done (default): one open copy at a time; finishing it creates the next. on_schedule: a new copy on every date whether or not the last one was done (an unfinished one stays overdue).

start_date.description: First date, YYYY-MM-DD in `timezone`. Defaults to due_at's date, else today. The first copy is due on the first matching date on or after it.

time.description: Due time of day, HH:MM in `timezone`. Defaults to due_at's time, else 09:00.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the dates are in, e.g. America/Los_Angeles. Defaults to America/New_York.

when_done_due.description: when_done only. on_schedule (default): the next copy is due on the next date of the schedule (never one already past). from_completion: due one interval after the day it was finished.

stop.description: true: stop the series. This copy stays as a normal to-do; copies already made ahead of their date are removed.

todo_id.description: The to-do, or any copy of a repeating series.

name: set_todo_repeat
